_what: ZK PASS 1 Gate 0 safety-set item: the Semaphore v4 artifacts the prover downloads, hashed and verified against the ceremony's OWN published outputs and independent public attestations. Every value below was computed or fetched on 2026-09-04 by scripts in this pass; SOURCES lists where each fact came from. Anything not verifiable is under ASSUMPTIONS, not here.

verificationKeyBundle.note: Per-depth vk_delta_2[] and IC[] arrays for depths 1..32; alpha/beta/gamma shared. Pinned in the client build (lib/zk/ceremony.ts) AND THE KEY BOTH VERIFIERS USE: lib/zk/prover/semaphore-worker.mjs and validator/zk.js each read THIS file, hash the bytes they read against this pin, slice the depth-20 key from the same bytes and call snarkjs.groth16.verify directly. @semaphore-protocol/proof's verifyProof() — which verifies against a copy inlined in its dist bundle that no pin covered (attack-2 finding 2) — is not called by any verifier.

ceremony.name: Semaphore Binary Merkle Root Fix
ceremony.why: Re-ceremony after the under-constrained BinaryMerkleRoot bug (OtterSec, reported 2025-05-28; zk-kit binary-merkle-root.circom v2.0.0 released 2025-06-30). The July-2024 'Semaphore V4 Ceremony' (docs anchor: Etherscan block 20300394) produced artifacts for the VULNERABLE circuit and is NOT what 4.13.0+ ships.

assumptions.A-ZKEY-VERIFY: snarkjs `zkey verify r1cs ptau zkey` was NOT run to completion: the ceremony's r1cs is not publicly readable (403 in the bucket) and a WASM circom (circom2@0.2.23) compiles the identical source to 15,896 constraints where the ceremony's circuit fits pot 13 (<= 8,192), i.e. a different compiler/optimizer. What IS established: the shipped zkey is byte-identical to the ceremony's published final zkey and its transcript embeds independently published contribution hashes. What is NOT mechanically established here: that the zkey's embedded circuit hash corresponds to the audited source (a malicious coordinator could in principle have finalized a zkey for a different circuit). TO CLOSE: obtain circom at the ceremony's compiler version (p0tion config, not public in DefinitelySetup), compile packages/circuits/src/semaphore.circom @ 3521c96b with MAX_DEPTH=20, then run `snarkjs zkey verify main.r1cs ppot_0080_13.ptau semaphore-20.zkey` and expect `ZKey Ok!` with a 386-entry contribution list ending in the beacon above.
assumptions.A-AUDIT-SCOPE: PSE's internal March-2024 audit covered v4.0.0; the BinaryMerkleRoot bug shows post-audit soundness issues occur. The 4.14.3 circuit is the post-fix circuit; no third-party audit of the fixed circuit was located (F7).
assumptions.A-HOST-INTEGRITY: snark-artifacts.pse.dev ships no checksums (its repo, archived 2026-08-19, lists 'File integrity' as not provided). The pins above are OURS; the live prover refuses any artifact whose sha256 differs.
